341:t_3:48.en:
$n
「What's the matter, you guys? All of you together...」

341:t_3:49.en:
$$カレン$$
「What are you saying! We came all this way because we were worried about you!」

341:t_3:52.en:
$$スザク$$
「Was it the influence of those $$血塗られた眼$$ after all that made you pass out?」

341:t_3:55.en:
$n
「I don't know how that mysterious space and the black $$アンゲロイ$$... and the $$テンシ$$ I've been chasing... are connected...」

341:t_3:56.en:
$$宗介$$
「If the $$血塗られた眼$$ still show up, does that mean $$ガドライト#pilot$$ wasn't the enemy of your family after all...」

341:t_3:57.en:
$n
「I half expected it... I can't say $$ガドライト#pilot$$ and the $$テンシ$$ are unrelated in my mind, but somewhere I always felt a gap between them.」

341:t_3:58.en:
$n
「Besides, the $$血塗られた眼$$ showed up at $$ラース・バビロン$$ too... There's surely some connection between the $$テンシ$$ and $$サイデリアル$$, but right now we have no way to pursue it...」

341:t_3:60.en:
$n
「Sorry for always making you worry. But... I'm fine.」

341:t_3:62.en:
$n
「I've managed somehow up to now. It'll be the same from here on.」

341:t_3:64.en:
$$カトル$$
「But I think I... understood a little about $n's $$血塗られた眼$$ from the fighting in that space, too.」

341:t_3:65.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Same here. ...So that's how you've always been fighting...」

341:t_3:67.en:
$n
「But even I got through it somehow. If it's you guys, that thing will never crush you.」

341:t_3:68.en:
$$カレン$$
「Listen to you. Figures, from the first one to stop being the quiet type.」

341:t_3:69.en:
$n
「I've seen for myself that people can change, thanks to a sickly young lady and the Red Devil of the Elevens.」

341:t_3:70.en:
$$カレン$$
「Looks like you'd better fix that habit of adding one word too many, and quickly.」

341:t_3:72.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Looks like there's no need to worry anymore.」

341:t_3:73.en:
$n
「Th-thank you, Miss $$スズネ$$. You stayed by my side the whole time I was unconscious, didn't you.」

341:t_3:74.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Don't worry about it. More importantly, take care of yourself.」

341:t_3:77.en:
$$カレン$$
「Don't tell me it's a replay of the $$時獄戦役$$...!?」

341:t_3:78.en:
$$カトル$$
「It may be understandable. Things have been hard all the way since the battle to take $$ラース・バビロン$$...」

341:t_3:79.en:
$n
「But even so, we now have a prospect of getting back to Earth.」

341:t_3:80.en:
$$デュオ$$
「From Mars, if we use $$インサラウム$$'s hyperspace navigation, we can get back to Earth without much time, too.」

341:t_3:81.en:
$n
「We return to Earth and pay the $$新地球皇国$$ back.」

341:t_3:82.en:
$$カレン$$
「And then, we fight $$バアル$$.」

341:t_3:83.en:
$$宗介$$
「The fighting goes on. We have no time to lose to despair or fear.」

341:t_3:84.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Before that, we investigate $$ＺＯＮＥ$$. We need to find out how $$アサキム$$ broke the seal.」

341:t_3:86.en:
$n
(And $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$, the accursed wanderer who hunts the $$スフィア$$s... Is that man planning to fight the $$サイデリアル$$ too...?)

341:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As I thought, the $$血塗られた眼$$ is still bothering you.」

341:t_10:6.en:
$n
「It's as I told $$宗介$$ and the others. There's nothing I can say at this point...」

341:t_10:7.en:
$n
「So I'll just deal with what's in front of me, one thing at a time.」

341:t_10:9.en:
$n
「I can manage my own problems myself. The problem is...」

341:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Who knows... She's not the troublesome student she used to be, after all...」

341:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As a man, why not fill the gap in her heart for her...!」

341:t_10:14.en:
$n
「I was a fool to ask you.」

341:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My apologies. I seem to be giddy over having wiped out that terrifying army.」

341:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I got so excited that I went and generated a 100Z $$Ｚチップ$$ myself. Of course, I've added it to the unit's stock.」

341:t_10:17.en:
$n
「Even at a time like this, AG is all about Z-Chips...」

341:t_10:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Naturally! That's what a dimensional merchant is all about!」

341:t_10:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Yes... And that is precisely our last hope.)

341:t_10:25.en:
$$クロウ$$
「So you're the AG everyone's been talking about...」

341:t_10:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm sorry I haven't been able to introduce myself until now.」

341:t_10:27.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Don't worry about it. I'm the newcomer here, so I'm the one who should be paying respects first.」

341:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A rather ennui-laden atmosphere hangs about you... Is it the debt that's troubling you, after all?」

341:t_10:29.en:
$$クロウ$$
「No... I've gotten used to that.」

341:t_10:31.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I knew it myself, but it's quite a shock to have someone else point it out.」

341:t_10:32.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...If you like, I can lend an ear to your troubles.」

341:t_10:34.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Strange. From what $$デュオ$$ and the others said, I'd heard you were a sexual-harassment robot who loves Z-Chips...」

341:t_10:35.en:
$$クロウ$$
「To me you look like someone with a deep heart and a big capacity.」

341:t_10:36.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You flatter me. I'm only an agent robot.」

341:t_10:37.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Let me guess: $$クロウ$$'s trouble is about women.」

341:t_10:38.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...You got me. Not a romance thing, though.」

341:t_10:39.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're still bothered by that mysterious woman we met in that space, aren't you.」

341:t_10:40.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Yeah... That lady... spoke to me through the $$スフィア$$.」

341:t_10:41.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Hmm... I confirmed the phenomenon on my end too, but as for analysis, that's a bit...」

341:t_10:42.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Trouble keeps coming one after another, and now something incomprehensible shows up again... I'm sick of woman trouble, you know.」

341:t_10:43.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As expected of $$クロウ$$, handsome in looks alone. Those are quite profound words.」

341:t_10:44.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Perfect timing. Does the $$Ｄトレーダー$$ have anything like a bouquet?」
